notes: app 1.11.6 (chart 0.10.0 unchanged). App: instance-scoped licenses — a LICENSE_KEY issued with scope "instance" now applies its limits and features to every organization on the box, so an appliance is licensed once instead of per organization; the installer accepts and persists LICENSE_KEY (secrets.LICENSE_KEY). Also carries 1.11.4/1.11.5 (drive upload, files sidebar revert, calendar tooltip, OnlyOffice bootstrap timeout). Chart: nothing to roll, the key rides the generic secrets block. app_version drives the app/sandbox/workbench image pins in values.yaml (the appliance pins them for offline safety, update.sh rewrites all four on apply); the four images are built under one version by suite-366's Publish Public Image workflow. Bump chart_version / app_version / vllm_image here to roll out to the fleet; appliances poll this file daily and notify (no auto-apply), and since the strictly-newer comparison landed a channel BEHIND a box is reported rather than offered. updater_sha256 and backup_sha256 are filled in by tools/sign-channel.sh - never by hand; they are what let an appliance trust the update.sh and backup.sh it fetches. restic_version and the two restic_sha256_* fields are pinned from lib/config.sh by the same script, so an appliance that grows a backup agent online can also fetch the binary that runs it - and verify it against a hash we signed rather than against whatever GitHub serves. backup_sha256 must be present: an appliance holding the package key REFUSES to refresh backup.sh without it, and a box whose updater rolls forward while its backup agent does not is a box that silently stops being backed up.
